title: Robustness for free: asymptotic size and power of max-tests in high dimensions
summary: Allowing for adversarial contamination and heavy tails, we study testing whether the mean of a high-dimensional random vector equals zero. Because standard max-tests based on sample averages are highly non-robust, we propose a max-test based on quantile-winsorized observations. The test controls asymptotic size under adversarial contamination and only requires $m>2$ moments, while allowing dimension to grow exponentially with sample size.
